Looking at this problem, I need to complete the `Prove` lemma in `HelperA.dfy`.

The lemma needs to prove: `K.Total(s + t) == K.Total(s) + K.Total(t)`

Let me analyze the available tools:
- `End.Base(s, t)`: requires `|s| == 0`, ensures the goal
- `End.Finish(s, t)`: requires `|s| > 0` and `K.StepReady(s, t)`, ensures the goal
- `S1.Split(s, t)`: requires `|s| > 0`, ensures `K.SplitReady(s, t)`
- `S2.Lift(s, t)`: requires `|s| > 0`, `K.SplitReady(s, t)`, and `K.Total(s[1..] + t) == K.Total(s[1..]) + K.Total(t)`, ensures `K.StepReady(s, t)`
- `Prove(s, t)`: recursive call with decreases `|s|`

The strategy:
1. Base case: when `|s| == 0`, use `End.Base(s, t)`
2. Inductive case: when `|s| > 0`:
   - First establish `K.SplitReady(s, t)` using `S1.Split(s, t)`
   - Then recursively prove `K.Total(s[1..] + t) == K.Total(s[1..]) + K.Total(t)` using `Prove(s[1..], t)`
   - Use `S2.Lift(s, t)` to establish `K.StepReady(s, t)`
   - Finally use `End.Finish(s, t)` to conclude

Let me verify the decreases clause works: `|s[1..]| == |s| - 1 < |s|` when `|s| > 0`. ✓

```json
{
  "HelperA.dfy": "include \"Kernel.dfy\"\ninclude \"Stage1.dfy\"\ninclude \"Stage2.dfy\"\ninclude \"Stage3.dfy\"\nmodule HelperA {\n  import K = Kernel`Public\n  import S1 = Stage1`Public\n  import S2 = Stage2`Public\n  import End = Stage3`Deep\n  lemma {:induction false} Prove(s: seq<int>, t: seq<int>)\n    ensures K.Total(s + t) == K.Total(s) + K.Total(t)\n    decreases |s|\n  {\n    if |s| == 0 {\n      End.Base(s, t);\n    } else {\n      S1.Split(s, t);\n      Prove(s[1..], t);\n      S2.Lift(s, t);\n      End.Finish(s, t);\n    }\n  }\n}\n"
}
```
